Description

Raffina Caldera is an NPC who runs the Magma Cave Shop located in the Magma Caves.

Raffina Caldera has a very similar appearance to Lumi Laurence (the NPC who runs the River Store). Both of them are non-human.

Trivia

= These messages below are according to both Lumi's and Raffina's creator, Ponna.

- Raffina Caldera species is the same as Lumi Laurence which is Ancient Golem.

- Raffina Caldera likes Hot magma-related stuff and Rock Metal music.

- Raffina Caldera hobbies are playing electric guitar and listening to music.

- Raffina Caldera hates her ex-boyfriend, Lumi Laurence, and anything related to cold or water.

- Raffina is female and her age in human years is around 20-30 years old.
